Setup

  1. Download AuroraSwitch.bin.
  2. Back up a FAT32 USB drive. Put AuroraSwitch.bin at its root as the only root BIN.
  3. Add supported firmware to aurora/, using the exact filenames in the reference.
  4. Safely eject, insert into Aurora and follow Qu-Bit's USB update procedure.
    Leave AuroraSwitch.bin at the root. Keep USB connected for selection and automatic boot.
